Tab. 5 provides the detailed finetuning hyperparameters for the pragmatic question answering task discussed in §4.1.

Tab. 6 provides the detailed finetuning hyperparameters for the image referential game discussed in §4.2. Since our focus is on how the VLM generates captions (i.e., how it arranges the wording), we do not finetune the VLM's image-encoder module, allowing it to maintain a stable and robust image embedding space throughout the experiments.
